INSERT INTO instruments ( symbol, name, asset_class, currency, metadata )
SELECT 'GEN'||LPAD(n::TEXT,4,'0'), 'Generated Instrument '||n, (ARRAY[ 'EQUITY', 'FIXED_INCOME', 'FX', 'COMMODITY', 'DERIVATIVE' ])[1+(n%5)],
(ARRAY[ 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'CHF' ])[1+(n%5)],
jsonb_build_object( 'generated',true )
FROM generate_series(1,45) n;
INSERT INTO trades ( trade_ref, instrument_id, counterparty_id, quantity, price, trade_date, status )
SELECT
'TRD-2026-'||LPAD(n::TEXT,6,'0'),
1+(n%50),
1+(n%10),
ROUND((100 + n * 10.25)::numeric,4),
ROUND((10 + n * 1.75)::numeric,4),
DATE '2026-04-01' +(n%120)*INTERVAL '1 day',
(ARRAY[ 'PENDING', 'MATCHED', 'UNMATCHED', 'DISPUTED' ]) [1+(n%4)]
FROM generate_series(1,500) n;
